title: Valuator Assistant (Mine Sampling)
description: Valuator Assistant (Mine Sampling). Requirements: Grade 12 or NQF 4; COM Basic Valuation Certificate; at least one year relevant experience; medical fitness. Duties: Observation and sampling at the stope face; orient measurements with survey pegs; record rock types and geological anomalies such as dykes and faults; measure stope widths and gully heights; enter data into the MRM system; stope plots.

title: HR Practitioner: Talent & Employment Equity
description: HR Practitioner: Talent & Employment Equity. Requirements: Diploma or degree in HR or related field; postgraduate HR desirable; at least 3 years HR experience in mining; talent management experience desirable; MS Office; medical fitness; talent management principles and HR legislation; presentation, administration and communication; confidentiality. Duties: Talent pool and succession planning database; performance management; Talent Management Framework support; mentorship programmes; IDP process; employment equity coordination; monthly Talent and EE reports; office administration; audits.

title: TM3 Foreman (Trackless Mobile Machinery)
description: TM3 Foreman (Trackless Mobile Machinery). Requirements: N3 plus diesel mechanic trade certificate; Grade 12 (NQF 4); MS Office; 3-5 years as artisan on underground trackless mobile machinery; hydraulics advantageous; interpret ISO schematic drawings; organising and delegation; overtime and standby; medical fitness. Duties: Supervise artisans maintaining and repairing trackless mobile machinery and compliance tests; control workshops; breakdown callouts; on-the-job training; plan daily and major maintenance; work orders; spares and consumables stock; projects; MHSA compliance; purchase requisitions and costs; liaise with suppliers; discipline.

title: Fitter & Turner (Concentrator Plant)
description: Fitter & Turner (Concentrator Plant). Requirements: Grade 12 with maths and science or N3 trade subjects; trade qualification (Section 13 or 26D) with completed apprenticeship; 3 years concentrator plant, 5 years underground mining or 5 years smelting; maintaining ball mills, crushers, conveyors, screens, flotation cells, filters, thickeners and pumps; hydraulic and mechanical fault-finding; preventive maintenance; driver's licence and own transport; medical Certificate of Fitness; standby duty. Duties: All mechanical work and plant reliability in assigned area; maintain conveyors, pumps, ball mill, flotation, crushers, thickeners and screens; hydraulic troubleshooting; strip and rebuild pumps; spares; inspections and housekeeping; equipment availability; MHSA compliance.

title: Ventilation Trainee (Mining)
description: Ventilation Trainee (Mining). Requirements: Grade 12 with Mathematics and Physical Science (essential); Intermediate Certificate in Mine Environmental Control advantageous; 2 years underground trackless mining experience; coordinating ventilation construction and sanitation crews; medical fitness. Duties: Monitor and report on ventilation and occupational hygiene; coordinate ventilation construction and sanitation crews; install and commission ventilation systems; monitor dust, gases, noise, temperature and lighting underground; sampling and testing; sanitation; main fan performance; audits and reports.

title: Senior HRIS Coordinator
description: Senior HRIS Coordinator. Requirements: Grade 12 or NQF 4; HR, IT, Finance or Data Science diploma or degree (essential); Honours advantageous; at least 5 years in a mine environment in HR or Finance, 3 in an HRIS department; medical fitness. Duties: Manage HR information systems and data integrity; reports, metrics and dashboards; system enhancements; troubleshoot HR system issues; train HR users; projects with business analysts; data extraction and analysis; model attendance, turnover and staffing trends.

title: Plant Operator (Concentrator)
description: Plant Operator (Concentrator). Requirements: Grade 12 (NQF 4) with maths and science; 1-3 years plant operator experience; plant training modules; crushing, milling and flotation knowledge; plant equipment operation; medical fitness; plant LDV driving and relief shift leader experience advantageous. Duties: Monitor and control plant process and equipment; corrective action; minor mechanical maintenance; lifting and rigging; daily operational targets safely; report deviations; housekeeping; record processing data on log sheets and checklists.

title: Electrician (Processing Plant)
description: Electrician (Processing Plant). Requirements: Grade 12 or N3 trade subjects; trade qualification (Section 13 or 26D) or completed apprenticeship; NTC 2 trade theory; minimum 3 years as artisan; processing plants, milling, flotation, crushers and pumps; 6.6 kV and 33 kV switching; medium-voltage fault-finding; substations; LV wiring; computer literacy, SAP an advantage; medical fitness. Duties: Electrical work and plant reliability; maintenance, fault-finding and breakdown repairs; work at heights; electrical network; legal inspections and testing; HT substation inspections; legal documents; quality management; supervise contractors; standby and overtime.

title: Diesel Mechanic (Underground Mining)
description: Diesel Mechanic (Underground Mining). Requirements: Grade 12; trade-tested diesel or earthmoving mechanic; 3 years diesel mechanic experience; Code B driver's licence; underground mining and TMM experience; medically fit; diagnostics, engine and hydraulic repair, welding and fabrication, record keeping, safety compliance, mentoring. Duties: Maintain, service and repair diesel vehicles and machinery; order spares; surface breakdown repairs; machine inspections and reports; safety talks; mine rules; identify training needs; engine overhauls and hydraulic systems.

title: Miner Production (Underground)
description: Miner Production (Underground). Requirements: Grade 12 or NQF 4; valid permanent blasting certificate; three years underground development experience or a national diploma or degree in mining engineering; Competent A and B certification; mine standards and risk management; stoping, development, surveying, equipping and explosives; safety policies and regulations. Duties: Allocate resources to the business plan; set production targets; pass shaft management instructions to the crew; supervise underground crews; plan, organise and control mining operations; drilling and blasting, marking holes, misfires and charging; install support with anchors and packs; move materials with a mono-rope system.
